tagline: Every RamPaceCorp game, in one place.

games.title: MSHSAA Basketball Manager 27
games.subtitle: Run a Missouri high school program
games.description: Take over a Missouri high school basketball program and build a dynasty. Recruit and develop players, play out the regular season, chase your conference title, and fight through districts and MSHSAA Madness for the state championship. Real schools, real rosters, box scores, stats and cloud saves.

games.title: Backrooms Unsighted
games.subtitle: Don't lose your way.
games.description: Wake up in the endless yellow halls of the Backrooms. Explore the maze, keep your nerve, and find a way out before something finds you. A first-person horror game built in Unity.

games.title: Survival Protocol
games.subtitle: Story campaign + 200-player Battle Royale
games.description: A story-driven military shooter. Fight through ten chapters as Jake Sarton, then drop onto Isla Corona: a 6 km island with 36 landmarks, 50 squads of 4, floor loot, golden chests, supply drops, launch pads, reboot vans, building and online squads. Plus Freeplay, Horde, a 100-tier Season Pass and 50+ guns.

games.title: Next Level Pick-Em
games.subtitle: Pick Missouri high school winners
games.description: Pick the winners of real Missouri high school games, stake your coins, and climb the leaderboard. Football, basketball, soccer, volleyball, baseball, softball and more, with schedules and final scores straight from MSHSAA. Underdog picks pay up to 5x.

games.title: VBL Volleyball League
games.subtitle: Teams, schedules, standings, playoffs
games.description: The home of the Volleyball League. Follow all 14 teams, from the St. Louis HardHitters to the San Diego Sails, with rosters, schedules, standings and the road through the playoffs.

games.title: NOVA
games.subtitle: Your personal AI assistant
games.description: NOVA is RamPaceCorp's voice assistant. This is NOVA Mobile: chat with NOVA from anywhere through your Claude account. It opens in Safari, so you stay signed in. The full NOVA, which opens apps, controls music and watches your battery, runs on your Windows PC.
